scope: Exact compatibility/browser-projects.json source selections with mps-overrides.bzl substitutions; Java only
coverage: simple retained subclasses of IntelliJ types
limits: Lexical inventory, not Java symbol or overload resolution
Resolved provider means the owning top-level source exists; a nested type or member may still be missing
Instance-member calls and implicit static imports require javac/J2CL for full validation
Wildcard imports and complex inheritance are recorded but not expanded
Subclass-qualified references are a conservative superset and may name members declared by the MPS subclass
Class-name strings are evidence only, not assumed executable reflective loads
